project.name: Pitkierie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 6 of 14. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. Private steadings and the dovecot are not presented as public attractions. Kilrenny and Anstruther services are not transferred.
